card.name: Word starts hinting at dining or stomach
card.fires_on: Short word-start pieces such as "d", "D", "intr", "Gast" or "P" that begin a word, often meaning dine or dose, or in gastric and stomach-acid text.

modes.label: Dine-like word starts
modes.description: A lone "d" begins a word like dined or dished in food-related text.
modes.example: If you've been around long enough to remember when McDonald's<< d>>ished up their 15-cent hamburg

modes.label: Dose word starts
modes.description: A capital D or d opens the word doses or dosed in dosing text.

card.writes: It pushes the word rest and weakly suppresses Chinese words for meal, dining and stomach.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters of words about eating or stomach acid, before the rest of the word appears.
